svg.aria-label: What the model actually receives. Raw schema: Salesforce fields like Id 0061E00001BnKLVQA3, StageName "Proposal/Price", Amount 480000.0 and IsWon false, so the model has to guess what they mean. Semantic context: the same deal as account Acme Corp, deal stage Proposal, amount $480,000, expected close September 30, 2026, win probability 65% and tier Enterprise, so the model answers accurately.
